headline: Vedant Fashions to host virtual investor meet on Sep 17
summary: Vedant Fashions Limited has scheduled a one-to-one virtual meeting with investors and analysts for September 17, 2026. The company confirmed that discussions will rely solely on publicly available information.

headline: HGM board meets Sep 17 for strategic investments
summary: Handson Global Management (HGM) Ltd schedules board meeting on September 17, 2026, to consider strategic investment opportunities under SEBI LODR Regulation 30.

headline: Ola Electric to host analyst meeting on Sep 17
summary: Ola Electric Mobility Ltd will host a one-to-one meeting with Emkay Global Financial Services Ltd on September 17, 2026, at its Future Factory and Giga Factory in Bengaluru.

headline: ACME Solar commissions 53.63 MW BESS in Rajasthan
summary: ACME Solar Holdings commissions Phase-I of its 53.63 MW BESS project in Rajasthan. The facility, part of a larger FDRE project, achieves commercial operation on September 16, 2026.

headline: Stocks in Focus: Solar, Blackbuck, Raghav
summary: Solar Industries signs massive ₹12,951 crore Omnia deal. Blackbuck surges 7% post stake sale. Raghav Productivity posts strong growth. Check full briefing.

headline: Piramal Pharma's Morpeth facility gets 7 FDA observations
summary: Piramal Pharma's Morpeth facility received seven observations following a US FDA inspection, signalling regulatory scrutiny at the manufacturing site.

headline: Jubilant Foodworks EVP Virender Singh Sehrawat resigns
summary: Jubilant Foodworks Ltd announced the resignation of EVP & Head of Integrated Supply Chain Virender Singh Sehrawat. He cited an external opportunity and will leave on November 13, 2026.

headline: HeidelbergCement India signs 50-year limestone deal in MP
summary: HeidelbergCement India has signed a 50-year agreement for 63 million tonne of limestone reserves in Madhya Pradesh, securing long-term raw material supply for its cement operations.

headline: India to ease BA/BE study rules for drug approvals
summary: The government aims to simplify the regulatory process for bioavailability and bioequivalence studies in domestic drug approvals, signalling a push to streamline pharmaceutical regulations in India.

headline: Coforge retains FY27 guidance, targets >100% FCF
summary: Coforge maintains FY27 EBIT margin >15.5% and FCF/PAT >100%. Nomura rates Buy with ₹1,860 target as board governance strengthens.

headline: Blue Cloud Softech joins IndiaAI Centre in Odisha
summary: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions confirmed as Industry Partner for IndiaAI Centre of Excellence in Bhubaneswar. The firm commits ₹4 crore and will provide mentorship to AI startups under MeitY approval.

headline: Flipkart may cap restaurant fees at 15-20%
summary: Flipkart is reportedly planning to cap restaurant commissions and ad spending at 15-20%, a move that could intensify competition in India's food delivery market against Swiggy and Eternal.

headline: Aditya Birla Housing Finance targets 15% ROE
summary: Aditya Birla Housing Finance aims for a 15% ROE and plans to nearly double its informal-income portfolio to 11% over the next 8-10 quarters, per a newspaper report.
